title: Stop Looking Back
seo_title: Letting Go of the Past: Philippians 3:13 | TheWrkShop
seo_description: The past is a reference point, not a residence. A devotional for men on Philippians 3:13 about regret, moving forward and living today.
verse_text: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead.
insight: The past is a reference point, not a residence.
one_minute_win: Write one regret on paper. Rip it up.
declaration: My past does not own my future.
